items.headline: Six thousand people made a three-minute film about a future worth living in
items.excerpt: Ten of them present live on Sept 25 in downtown LA. The winner leaves with a $2.5M grant to go make it for real.

items.headline: 'The Vale - Origins': AI Through the Lens of Grief and Creativity
items.excerpt: Abigail Hing Wen's directorial debut is a hybrid animated/live-action short about a 5-year-old who draws his way out of grief, and the parents who build his sketches into an AI-powered virtual sanctuary – made without AI.

items.headline: Scantic trains 3D Gaussian Splats entirely on your phone
items.excerpt: New iOS app generates 3DGS scans of objects and environments entirely on your phone, without cloud processing. The base app is free.

items.headline: Cocomelon's Studio Tells Its Artists to Start Experimenting With AI
items.excerpt: Moonbug Entertainment, which makes Cocomelon, Blippi, and other popular content for children, says it will begin using AI but will always have a 'human in the loop.'

items.headline: Inside the Chinese AI Studio Shrinking Short-Drama Crews to One
items.excerpt: Former animators, cinematographers, and VFX artists are helping build AI systems that can script, storyboard, generate, and revise short dramas with unprecedented speed.
